modern: In general, wickedness does no harm at all to the universe; and in particular the wickedness of one man does no harm to another. It is harmful only to him who has it in his power to be released from it as soon as he chooses.
original: Generally, wickedness does no harm at all to the universe; and particularly the wickedness [of one man] does no harm to another. It is only harmful to him who has it in his power to be released from it as soon as he shall choose.
